verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an agent-orchestration platform that stores tasks, workspaces and automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature or open-format data dump. Local-first storage, Git branches and PRs, and the API, SDK and CLI are only adjacent or developer building blocks; they are not a documented 'export all data and leave' capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
